a.lede: ​Apple has backported security patches released last month to older iPhones and iPads, addressing a zero-day bug exploited in "extremely sophisticated" targeted attacks on iOS devices. [...]
a.title: Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones

b.lede: Apple soon won't need to physically access iPhones like the new Duo before updating them or checking returns.
b.title: Apple will reportedly run diagnostics on returned iPhones without opening the packaging
